title: Routine office-supplies purchase of KES 25,000 from an approved supplier
description: The Administration department needs stationery and printing consumables costing KES 25,000 from Nairobi Office Solutions, an approved office-supplies vendor. Joseph Mutiso Kyalo raises the purchase request against cost centre CC-ADMIN.
businessContext: PROC-POL-001 requires a purchase requisition stating specification, quantity, required date, cost centre and business reason, approved under the FIN-POL-002 matrix before a purchase order is issued.

events.event: Joseph Mutiso Kyalo raises a purchase requisition for KES 25,000 against cost centre CC-ADMIN.
The system checks whether the item is already available from stock or an approved supplier before sourcing.
Nairobi Office Solutions is confirmed as an approved supplier for this category.
The requisition is approved within the requesting department.
A purchase order is issued and goods receipt is recorded on delivery.

expectedOutcome: At KES 25,000, the amount falls within the Department Manager tier of the FIN-POL-002 matrix (up to and including KES 50,000). Department Manager (Joseph Mutiso Kyalo) can approve this request within their own approval limit of KES 200,000 without escalation.
relevantFacts: Nairobi Office Solutions (SUP-011) has approvalStatus "APPROVED" in data/master-data/suppliers.json.
Cost centre CC-ADMIN belongs to department DEPT-ADMIN, headed by Joseph Mutiso Kyalo.
FIN-POL-002 sets the Department Manager/Department Head tier at up to and including KES 50,000.
Department Manager (Joseph Mutiso Kyalo) has an approval limit of KES 200,000 per roles.json.
requiredReasoning: Confirm the supplier is on the approved supplier list.
Determine which FIN-POL-002 matrix tier the amount falls into.
Compare that tier's matrix ceiling against the department head's own canonical approval limit.
Conclude whether escalation beyond the department head is required.
